Package com.eventlottery.model

Class Attendee

java.lang.Object
com.eventlottery.model.AbstractUser
com.eventlottery.model.Attendee
public class Attendee extends AbstractUser
Represents an Attendee in the Event Lottery System. Stores personal information, event history, and waitlist status. Automatically synchronizes changes with Firebase Firestore.
